scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a housing loan and was wondering if you could provide me with an update on the status of my application. I'm looking to purchase a home and I'm eager to know where I stand. Could you also tell me if my application was approved, denied, or is still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated. May I help you with anything else?

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Could you please tell me the interest rate that was assigned to my loan and the total costs associated with it? Also, I'd like to know if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan.
dialogue.agent: The interest rate for your loan is 6.875%. The total costs associated with your loan amount to $8,237.19. The loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Can you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? Additionally, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has not been sold to another institution. You were approved for a conventional first lien loan product.

dialogue.user:
Got it. Thank you for the information. I think that's all I needed to know for now. <Satisfied>
The agent provided clear and concise answers to all of my questions, which helped me understand the status and details of my loan application. I appreciate their assistance.
